name: null-startup
description: Startup profiler for Null IDE — startup phases, extension activation times, launch history and comparison

commands.title: Null Startup: Export Startup Report as JSON…

null-startup.enabled.description: Record a startup report on every launch. Takes effect on the next start.

null-startup.retention.description: How many startup reports to keep for comparison. Older reports are deleted.

null-startup.slowExtensionMs.description: Extensions whose activation takes at least this long are flagged 'slow' in the report. A slow activation is not necessarily a problem.

scripts.compile: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-report-shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-report.json
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-report-shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview-report.json && node --test out/test/snapshot.test.js out/test/settings.test.js out/test/intervals.test.js out/test/sanitize.test.js out/test/buildReport.test.js out/test/reportStore.test.js out/test/capture.test.js out/test/compare.test.js out/test/exportReport.test.js out/test/reportModel.test.js out/test/reportWebviewModel.test.js out/test/reportHtml.test.js
